requirement_vague: Delete a none existing item and confirm the API reports 'Item not found'. Admin credentials: (admin@example.com / password123)

implementation.reasoning: The delete_item route handles DELETE /api/v1/items/{item_id} with authentication. When the item is not found, it raises a 404 HTTPException with the detail 'Item not found', matching the requirement exactly. The superuser credentials (admin@example.com / password123) are initialized via init_superuser() and can authenticate via the login endpoint.
